content: Supabase Auth JWT verification in a custom Express backend: verify signature via JWKS (/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json) for asymmetric keys, NOT decode-only. Common mistakes: trusting unverified JWT, missing audience/issuer (issuer must include /auth/v1 suffix), exposing service_role key (bypasses RLS), JWKS cache expiry (wait 20min on key rotation), backend still verifying against legacy HS256 secret after rotating to asymmetric keys.
